card.name: Space before a number in tables
card.fires_on: A space (or the start of a digit) right before a number after a label such as Cycle, Grade, Table, Phase or a dash. It is most common in clinical trial tables and section numbers.

modes.label: Label then number
modes.description: Space after a word like Cycle, Grade, Table or Phase, just before the number.
modes.example: Grade Definition Grade<< >>0 No change or none Grade 1

modes.label: Range or threshold
modes.description: Space inside a dose range or after a symbol like ≥, before the number.

modes.label: Section number
modes.description: Gap before a numbered section heading such as 5.4.

card.plain: It fires on the gap just before a number in table headings, cycle labels and section numbers.
